# Carson's Soft Wash Inc.

> Licensed and insured ARMA-compliant soft washing and exterior cleaning company serving Groveland, Clermont, Minneola, and the broader Lake County, FL region.

Carson's Soft Wash Inc. is a Central Florida exterior cleaning company specializing in roof soft washing, house washing, paver sealing, pool screen enclosure cleaning, and commercial pressure washing. The company uses low-pressure ARMA-compliant soft wash methods that eliminate Gloeocapsa Magma (the cyanobacterium behind black roof streaks), algae, and mold without damaging shingles, tile, or stucco. Carson's offers a 1-year no-streak warranty and results that typically last 3–5 years on roofs and 1–2 years on house exteriors in Florida's humid climate.

## Services

- [Soft Wash Roof Cleaning](/services): Low-pressure ARMA-compliant roof cleaning that removes algae, mold, and black streaks from asphalt shingles, tile, and metal roofs. Lasts 3–5 years.
- [House Washing](/services): Full exterior house washing using soft wash technique safe for stucco, vinyl siding, block, and painted surfaces.
- [Driveway & Paver Cleaning](/services): High-pressure cleaning of concrete driveways and paver surfaces, followed by optional sealing and re-sanding.
- [Paver Sealing & Sanding](/services): Paver re-sanding and sealing to restore color, lock in joint sand, prevent weeds, and protect against staining.
- [Pool Screen Enclosure Cleaning](/services): Soft washing of pool lanai screens, aluminum and vinyl frames, and the surrounding deck — removing algae, oxidation, and dirt without tearing screen material.
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](/services): Commercial exterior cleaning for retail, industrial, and multi-family properties across Lake County, FL.
